concerns.text: Implementation mentions loading `layoutlmv3-base` (or ResNet‑18). The spec and constitution require a **CPU‑only frozen visual encoder** (ResNet‑18). Allowing `layoutlmv3-base` introduces a potential GPU dependency and weakens FR‑001.

Baseline model description says it re‑uses the same DistilBERT **without any projection head**, contradicting the plan’s “frozen random linear projection head” for capacity control and FR‑009 (baseline must be re‑trained per seed with identical architecture). This weakens the functional requirement.

Verification for T005 checks validation MSE improvement but never records or compares against a **random‑init baseline MSE**. SC‑001 explicitly requires measuring improvement against that baseline via a paired t‑test, so the acceptance criterion is missing.

Spec’s SC‑006 page‑count minimum is left as a `[deferred]` placeholder, yet T001 enforces a hard **10 000‑page** threshold. Introducing a concrete value without it being reflected in the spec silently changes the requirement.

FR‑002 mandates the entire distillation pipeline complete **within 6 h** on a CPU‑only runner. T005 runs **15 separate seeds**, each allowed up to 5 h, which inevitably exceeds the 6‑hour budget when all seeds are executed, violating the resource‑constraint principle.

T012 only checks the total wall‑clock after the full pipeline; it does not enforce the 6‑hour limit per the constitution. Combined with T005’s 15‑seed schedule, the pipeline will exceed the allowed runtime, breaching VI. Resource‑Constrained Computational Efficiency.

If the frozen visual encoder cannot be loaded on CPU, T003 aborts with a RuntimeError and does not provide a fallback or alternative path. FR‑001 requires generating a visual latent for **every document with valid annotations**; aborting on a single failure violates completeness.
